name: Afflicted
overview: Scripture reveals a clear duty to show compassion and practical care toward the afflicted, emphasizing kindness from friends (Job 6:14) and lifting up the humble in their distress (Job 22:29). Isaiah 58 highlights God's chosen fast as one that frees the oppressed, loosens burdens, and provides for the hungry and naked, demonstrating that true worship involves tangible acts of mercy (Isaiah 58:6-7, 10). This care reflects God’s heart and is connected to the blessings promised by Christ, who calls His followers to inherit the kingdom prepared for those who serve the needy (Matthew 25:34).
